library.title: Snippet library
library.description: Your snippets stay on this computer. Save changes explicitly.
library.support: Windows prototype · Expansion follows your activation choice in Preferences. Saving refreshes the running engine automatically.
library.probeActive: A Developer probe session is active. Stop it before starting the library.
library.emptyDescription: Try another search or create a snippet.
library.field.title: Title
library.triggerHelp: Use an abbreviation such as :email or ;hello, without spaces.
library.bodyHelp: Your replacement text. Unicode, tabs and line breaks are supported.
library.chooseDescription: Select a saved snippet or create a new one to start writing.
library.discardDescription: Your draft has not been saved. Continue editing or discard it to proceed.
library.folderHelp: Removing a folder moves its snippets to Unfiled. Snippets are kept.
library.importHelp: Import adds records. Conflicting identities or active triggers are refused without changing the library.
library.pickerHelp: Choose Copy or press Enter for the first result, then paste where you need it. Escape closes the picker.
library.validation.title: Enter a name of 1–120 characters.
library.validation.trigger: Enter 1–128 characters without whitespace or control characters.
library.validation.body: Use at most 1,000,000 Unicode characters. Only Tab and line breaks are allowed as control characters.
library.validation.duplicateTrigger: This trigger is already used by an enabled snippet.
library.error.invalidData: The library contains invalid data. Nothing was saved.
library.error.conflict: The library changed in another window. Your draft is kept. Reload before saving again.
library.error.storage: The library could not be saved. Your draft is kept. Check disk access and try again.
library.error.tooLarge: This file exceeds the 8 MiB import limit.
library.error.unsupportedVersion: This library format is not supported.
library.error.unavailable: Open the Texpio desktop app to use the native library. If it is already open, retry the operation.
library.error.importConflict: The file conflicts with existing IDs or active triggers, or the library changed. No records were imported. Review the file or reload.
product.error.cancelled: Insertion stopped. Check the text before continuing.
product.error.targetChanged: Insertion stopped because the active field changed.
product.error.modifiersHeld: Release Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Windows keys before expanding.
product.error.inputBlocked: Windows blocked input. Check the text before trying again.
product.error.clipboard: The clipboard is unavailable. Check the text before trying again.
product.error.busy: The expansion engine is busy. Stop it and try again.
product.error.unavailable: The Windows expansion service is unavailable.
product.settingsError: Expansion settings could not be saved. Your previous settings are kept.
product.field.allowSoftwareInput: Remote keyboard and key remapper compatibility
product.typeNotice: Typing uses a slower pace in Windows Notepad. Use Paste for longer text. Compatibility with other apps is still being tested.
product.softwareInputHelp: Allows typing sent by other applications to trigger your snippets.
product.activationHelp: Correct typos with Backspace and retyping. In immediate mode, a shorter abbreviation expands before a longer one with the same prefix. Choose After Space or punctuation for overlapping abbreviations.
product.error.attachmentMissing: An attachment is missing or unreadable. Review the snippet files before expanding.
attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.help: Files are saved immediately. Add files or paste a file/image here (up to 6 MiB when pasting).
attachments.error: The files could not be updated. Try again.
attachments.saveFirst: Save the snippet before adding files.
location.title: Library location
location.help: Choose a local folder shared with another Texpio instance. Personal snippets stay in place. Use a local disk, not a network or synced folder.
location.error: The library location could not be opened or changed. Your existing library is preserved.
backups.title: Backups and recovery
backups.mergeHelp: Merge keeps identical existing snippets and their files. Choose Replace to restore a full snapshot.
backups.counts: {{folders}} folders, {{snippets}} snippets, {{skipped}} unchanged. Backup contains {{files}} attached files.
backups.replaceHelp: This replaces the current library. A database backup is saved before applying it.
backups.recoveryHelp: Recovery is available only when database corruption is verified. ZIP backups include attached files; JSON and YAML contain text and metadata.
backups.recoveryConfirm: Preserve the corrupt database and its WAL/SHM files in a recovery folder, then create a fresh library? Expansion will stop.
backups.error: The operation failed. Your existing library and any preserved backups remain available.
backups.recovered: A fresh library was created. The original database files are preserved in the recovery folder.
library.metadataError: Favorites or usage information is unavailable.
dashboard.title: Library overview
product.field.closeToTray: Keep running when the window closes
product.desktopHelp: Sign-in launch opens Texpio in the tray. Enable expansion on launch separately. Shortcuts require a modifier; conflicts leave the previous binding active.
product.clipboardIncomplete: Some clipboard formats could not be restored.
product.error.shortcutUnavailable: A keyboard shortcut is unavailable. Choose another shortcut in Preferences.
workspace.noResultsHelp: Try a different search or choose another folder.
workspace.emptyListHelp: Create a snippet or choose another collection.
